name: Lamb Performance
hook: Your customers drive out past Henry's Mini-Mart because Mr. Ed reads a Nissan or a Mazda the way the dealer does and charges like an independent — the ones who haven't found you yet could see that, your hours and a way to book on one page. We built a trial version of that page. Take a look:
fakt: you run Lamb Performance as a family shop on Highway 501 West outside Conway, Mr. Ed has been an ASE Master Technician since 1989 with factory training from Nissan, Mazda, Mitsubishi and Hyundai, you offer a night drop, and you're looking for a full-time mechanic
na_stronie: your name, phone, e-mail and the Highway 501 address up front, your services in your own words (electrical issues and diagnostics, A/C repair, tune-ups and maintenance, brakes, belts and hoses, clutches, timing belts, transmission flush), Monday–Friday 8–5 with the night drop, online booking and a contact form that lands in your inbox, and your own photos of the shop front, the bays and the TR6
dlaczego: People who search for a mechanic on their phone pick the shop whose page shows what it does and lets them book. A page on your own domain with Mr. Ed's credentials, your services and a booking button turns that search into a car in the bay.
